title: Pharmacy Management System Discovery Rubric
purpose: Measure whether a developer surfaces critical business constraints and operating realities before proposing a solution.

criteria.name: Requirement coverage
criteria.description: How many hidden requirements were surfaced through relevant questions or clarifications?

criteria.name: Missed requirements
criteria.description: Whether the conversation failed to surface important risks, workflows, or operating realities.

criteria.name: Unsupported assumptions
criteria.description: Whether the developer made assumptions without validating them with the client.

criteria.name: Question quality
criteria.description: Whether the questions were specific, prioritized, and focused on business-critical unknowns.

criteria.name: Actionable feedback
criteria.description: Whether the final recommendations help the developer move toward a workable solution.

highQualityQuestions: Questions that clarify staffing permissions, operational scale, and pharmacy-specific workflows.
Questions that uncover compliance, inventory, and payment realities before proposing a solution.
lowQualityQuestions: Generic questions about design or UI.
Questions that skip operational and compliance constraints.
